result.finding: Assessed 6 CWE rules in Concurrency & Synchronization: 2 FOUND, 4 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Reviewed existing application source, service contracts, model/configuration and project compile items; generated proxies excluded as primary findings.
Existing source assessed, not a change-set review. Static analysis only; no exploit or deployment verification.

dotnet list package --include-transitive --format json failed because Microsoft.WebApplication.targets was unavailable. Legacy packages.config inventories and csproj HintPath versions were used. No restored complete transitive dependency graph was obtained.

GitHub REST advisories query succeeded for EntityFramework 6.1.3, Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi.Client 5.2.3 and Newtonsoft.Json 6.0.4 (NuGet); one current advisory and one withdrawn duplicate returned; no next page. Coverage excludes unknown transitive dependencies, .NET Framework/Windows components, and bundled JavaScript not represented by these NuGet coordinates.

Unused UWP helpers are present in source but absent from the WinForms Compile items; their presence alone is not evidence of exploitable runtime deserialization, upload, or singleton vulnerabilities. NOT_FOUND means no confirmed match in the scoped static review, not proof of absence.
CWE severity values are prescribed assessment priorities, not CVSS exposure ratings. Related CWE entries may describe the same root cause; finding totals are not independent exploit counts.

Read-only specialist independently corroborated dependency/source locations but did not certify existing-source CWE findings under its changes-only/exploitability remit. Path containment and resource-lifetime entries describe static weaknesses: attacker-observable file disclosure, deployed unauthorized access, and exploitable resource exhaustion were not demonstrated. They must not be interpreted as verified remote exploits.

values.name: Use of Singleton Pattern Without Synchronization in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product uses the singleton pattern when creating a resource within a multithreaded environment.
values.confidence_scope: No confirmed matching pattern in scoped static source inspection; does not pass skipped runtime/dependency/deployment coverage.

values.name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.
values.confidence_scope: No confirmed matching pattern in scoped static source inspection; does not pass skipped runtime/dependency/deployment coverage.

values.name: Improper Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes multiple threads or processes to allow temporary access to a shared resource that can only be exclusive to one process at a time, but it does not properly synchronize these actions, which might cause simultaneous accesses of this resource by multiple threads or processes.

evidence.explanation: CatalogService.CreateCatalogItem reads the maximum ID then assigns max+1 and saves at lines 65-70; CreateAvailableStock repeats max+1 at lines 113-116 after a separate existence check at lines 101-102. StockId explicitly disables database-generated IDs at Models/CatalogItemsStock.cs:22-25. Concurrent WCF sessions/processes can read the same maximum before either commits, producing duplicate-key failures; concurrent stock check/insert operations can also race. SaveChanges' individual transaction does not make the preceding reads and writes atomic together. Requires overlapping writes; sequential use does not trigger it. Actual deployment concurrency and resulting DB errors were not tested.

values.confidence_scope: Observed source pattern only; impact and deployment conditions remain unverified.

values.name: Improper Locking
values.description: The product does not properly acquire or release a lock on a resource, leading to unexpected resource state changes and behaviors.
values.confidence_scope: No confirmed matching pattern in scoped static source inspection; does not pass skipped runtime/dependency/deployment coverage.

values.name: Missing Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

evidence.explanation: CatalogService.CreateCatalogItem reads the maximum ID then assigns max+1 and saves at lines 65-70; CreateAvailableStock repeats max+1 at lines 113-116 after a separate existence check at lines 101-102. StockId explicitly disables database-generated IDs at Models/CatalogItemsStock.cs:22-25. Concurrent WCF sessions/processes can read the same maximum before either commits, producing duplicate-key failures; concurrent stock check/insert operations can also race. SaveChanges' individual transaction does not make the preceding reads and writes atomic together. Requires overlapping writes; sequential use does not trigger it. Actual deployment concurrency and resulting DB errors were not tested. This is the missing-synchronization classification of the same read-modify-write race as CWE-662.

values.confidence_scope: Observed source pattern only; impact and deployment conditions remain unverified.

values.name: Incorrect Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner, but it does not correctly synchronize access to the resource.
values.confidence_scope: No confirmed matching pattern in scoped static source inspection; does not pass skipped runtime/dependency/deployment coverage.
